Scorchclaw Pup

450 goldStarting item

A jungle starting pet that helps you kill monsters and, once grown, makes your next attack or ability burn and slow enemies.

Stats

No stats.

What it does

Jungle Companions: Summon a Scorchclaw that assists you against monsters.

The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and periodically imbues your next Attack or Ability to burn enemies and Slow them. Killing large monsters readies this immediately.

When to buy it

Pick it as a jungler who deals damage and wants to gank: the slow helps you catch laners.

Skip it whenOnly buy a jungle pet if you take Smite and play jungle.

Good on

Diana Ekko Taliyah Kayn Kha'Zix
